lead_raw_text:
The structure of Al₆Zr₂ (reduced formula Al₃Zr) crystallizes in the monoclinic space group C2/c (No. 15), with a unit cell containing 32 atoms (Al₂₄Zr₄) distributed over five independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Al centers with 12 geometric neighbors, adopting a close-packed-like local arrangement, while Zr centers have 16 neighbors; these environments are described as coordination polyhedra rather than chemical bonds. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner, edge, and face sharing among 12-vertex Al polyhedra, and corner and face sharing between 12-vertex Al and 16-vertex Zr polyhedra. The periodic neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 32 sites.
